scope: Frozen published 14-case method revision: 26 previously opened regression tasks and 8 registered targets from 4 parameter groups. Compare the published 13-case baseline on the same 8 targets. No consumer LLM, author revision, source fits or author-history transfer.

parameter_registration.prerequisite: Actual published same-source14/14method; freeze exact source before any target evidence.
parameter_registration.parameter_scope: Four new apparatus parameter groups, each with two dependent interaction-weight conditions (-0.65,1.6); historical square response and source window_width3 retained. Tests new parameters in the learned window family, not unseen structure or independent learning replications.
parameter_registration.comparison: Both frozen methods use the same original source archive, task, prefix seeds, per-case allowances and scoring. Previous26cases retain their prior effective caps. No consumer LLM, scientific source edits, fitted source data or author history in target workspaces. All research in both arms stops before terminal scoring.
parameter_registration.execution_reuse: Existing published_source, prepare_published_targets, frozen_transfers, score_frozen and paired frozen orchestration.
parameter_registration.failure_policy: Keep every completed target including failures. Resume only unfinished work; no target-informed author revision in this frozen batch.
parameter_registration.evaluation_scope: Each laboratory retains its public trajectory horizon; nested_response confirmation and terminal segments have up to64steps.

registration.scope: Complete both published research arms before either terminal scoring.
